newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks gather dust in flat London trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks gather dust in flat London trade.

text.p: Sleepy trading of Hong Kong stocks in London resulted in a flat market on Thursday, in contrast to the Hang Seng index, which fell one percent after a confused start caused by a computer glitch in the opening quote calculation.
At 1530 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference was virtually unchanged -- down just 0.52 points to 13,052.76, after the Hong Kong Hang Seng closed off 136.32 points at 13,053.28.
Dealers reported very low turnover all day.
"The market is basically flat," said one trader. "The focus is on the United States at the moment. Everybody is waiting for the U.S. retail figures and CPI due out tonight."
Asked if Wednesday's losses could be recouped on Friday he said: "I wouldn't have thought so. The markets are still very nervous."
